nodes.description: Private owner address; privileged address set to msg.sender in the constructor and used for all access-control checks.
Public mapping address => uint tracking token balances; mutated by transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested mapping address => address => uint of spending allowances; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Private mapping address => uint counting per-address sale operations; incremented in transferFrom, read in condition.
Private mapping address => bool whitelist of addresses allowed to sell; set in _mints, read in ensure.
Private minimum sale amount, set once in init, read in condition.
Private maximum sale amount, set once in init, read in condition.
Private per-address sale count limit used in condition.
Address of the trade contract, settable by owner via setTradeAddress and whitelisted in ensure.
Public total token supply, set in the constructor.
Public token name, set in the constructor.
Public token symbol, set in the constructor.
Public constant decimals = 18, used for scaling amounts.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address used for whitelist comparison in ensure.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
Internal view whitelist/gating function computing the Uniswap pair via pairFor and checking owner, UNI, tradeAddress, canSale and condition.
Public payable transferFrom: updates allowance, calls ensure, then mutates balances with unchecked arithmetic and increments _onSaleNum.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly with no zero-allowance guard.
Internal view sale-limit logic reading _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Public payable owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address and calldata.
Public mint function restricted to owner or a hard-coded address; overwrites balanceOf[spender] and whitelists the spender in canSale.
Public owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum from scaled inputs.
Public payable owner-only batch transfer looping over an address array with unchecked arithmetic on balances and total.
Public owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist state variable.
Internal pure Uniswap V2 pair address derivation via keccak256 with a hard-coded init code hash.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner (msg.sender), initial balance and an infinite allowance to the Uniswap router.
msg.sender, the untrusted external caller that drives transfer/transferFrom/approve and all owner-gated functions.
Arbitrary low-level delegatecall a.delegatecall(b) executed inside delegate, allowing foreign code to run in the token's storage context.
Unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom: allowance[..] -= _value, balanceOf[_from] -= _value, balanceOf[_to] += _value and _onSaleNum[_from]++.
Unchecked arithmetic in batchSend: total = _value * _tos.length, balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total and balanceOf[_to] += _value.
Unchecked arithmetic in _mints: addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) used to overwrite the spender balance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable in the constructor.
transfer() implicitly passes msg.sender as the source address into transferFrom.
msg.sender is used in transferFrom as the spender for the allowance check and decrement.
approve() writes allowance for msg.sender as the owner.
delegate() gates on msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall.
_mints() requires msg.sender to be owner or a hard-coded address before minting.
init() requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale parameters.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before mass distribution.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before updating the whitelist address.
Constructor sets owner and initial balance from msg.sender.
transfer() delegates its logic to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom() calls ensure() as a gating requirement before balance mutation.
ensure() falls back to condition() when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address for the whitelist check.
transferFrom() reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom() reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from].
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
condition() reads _saleNum.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from].
condition() reads _minSale.
condition() reads _maxSale.
ensure() compares _from/_to against the owner whitelist.
ensure() reads the canSale whitelist mapping.
ensure() compares _from against tradeAddress.
ensure() compares _from against the constant UNI address.
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender].
_mints() sets canSale[spender] = true.
init() sets _minSale.
init() sets _maxSale.
init() sets _saleNum.
batchSend() reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for msg.sender and each recipient.
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress state variable.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
Constructor sets totalSupply from _supply.
Constructor sets name.
Constructor sets symbol.
Constructor grants the entire supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor sets an infinite allowance to the Uniswap router.
delegate() forwards control to an arbitrary address through delegatecall, letting external code execute in this contract's storage context.
transferFrom() performs subtraction/addition on allowance, balances and _onSaleNum without SafeMath.
batchSend() multiplies and subtracts balances without SafeMath, risking overflow/underflow.
_mints() multiplies addedValue by 10**decimals without SafeMath before overwriting the balance.
transfer._to flows into transfer().
transfer._value flows into transfer().
transferFrom._from flows into transferFrom().
transferFrom._to flows into transferFrom().
transferFrom._value flows into transferFrom() and its unchecked arithmetic.
approve._spender flows into approve().
approve._value flows into approve().
delegate.a is the target address of the delegatecall.
delegate.b is the calldata payload of the delegatecall.
_mints.spender is used as the balance and whitelist key.
_mints.addedValue flows into the unchecked multiplication.
init.saleNum flows into _saleNum.
init.token flows into _minSale.
init.maxToken flows into _maxSale.
batchSend._tos flows into the distribution loop.
batchSend._value flows into the unchecked totals and transfers.
setTradeAddress.addr flows into the tradeAddress state variable.
constructor._name flows into name.
constructor._symbol flows into symbol.
constructor._supply flows into totalSupply.
ensure._UNI is the pair address used in the ensure whitelist checks.
batchSend.total is used to check and decrement the sender balance.
batchSend.i drives the distribution loop.
batchSend._to is the per-iteration recipient.
pairFor.token0 is the lower token address used in the hash.
pairFor.token1 is the higher token address used in the hash.
pairFor.pair is the computed return value of the pair derivation.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to only serves as an argument of transfer(); it has no independent semantic identity.
Parameter _value only serves as an argument of transfer().
Parameter _from is only consumed inside transferFrom() for allowance and balance lookups.
Parameter _to is only consumed inside transferFrom() for the recipient balance update.
Parameter _value feeds directly into the unchecked arithmetic performed by transferFrom().
Parameter _spender is only used as the allowance mapping key inside approve().
Parameter _value is only used as the allowance amount inside approve().
Parameter a is the delegatecall target consumed only by delegate().
Parameter b is the raw calldata passed into the arbitrary delegatecall.
Parameter spender is only used as the balance and whitelist key inside _mints().
Parameter addedValue is the operand of the unchecked multiplication in _mints().
Parameter saleNum is only written into _saleNum by init().
Parameter token is only scaled into _minSale by init().
Parameter maxToken is only scaled into _maxSale by init().
Parameter _tos is only iterated over inside batchSend().
Parameter _value feeds the unchecked total and per-recipient arithmetic in batchSend().
Parameter addr is only assigned to tradeAddress by setTradeAddress().
Constructor parameter _name is only assigned to the name state variable.
Constructor parameter _symbol is only assigned to the symbol state variable.
Constructor parameter _supply is only scaled into totalSupply.
Local _UNI exists solely to hold the pair address compared in ensure().
Local total is the product of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend().
Loop index i is a purely mechanical iteration variable of batchSend().
Loop-local _to is just the current element of _tos inside batchSend().
Local token0 is a temporary ordering variable inside pairFor().
Local token1 is a temporary ordering variable inside pairFor().
Local pair is the computed return value produced by pairFor().
